subject: general
question: ________ is the currency in the hands of the public plus commercial bank reserves, also called ‘high-powered money’.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monetary base.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• High-powered money is a** macroeconomic term** pertaining to the financial base, which is controlled by the institution in a country that **controls financial policy.**
 
• This is generally either the** finance ministry or the central bank.**
 
• The financial base is called high-powered because the magnitude of changes in the financial base is greatly magnified by the plutocrat multiplier.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Desired reserve ratio:**

 
 
• The reserve ratio is an important tool of the monetary policy of an economy and plays an essential role in regulating the money supply.
 
• When the central bank wants to increase the money supply in the economy, it lowers the reserve ratio.
 
• As a result, commercial banks have higher funds to disburse as loans, thereby increasing the money supply in an economy.
 
 
 
• **Excess reserve:**
 
 
• Excess reserves are capital reserves held by a bank or financial institution in excess of what's needed by controllers, creditors, or internal controls.
 
• For marketable banks, redundant reserves are measured against standard reserve demand quantities set by central banking authorities.
 
 
 
• **Money multiplier:**
 
 
• The phenomenon in which money is created in the form of the creation of credits in the economy is referred to as the money multiplier and is based on the fractional reserve banking system.
